question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A short interesting or amusing story
solution:
The correct answer is '**Anecdote**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Anecdote**'.
 
• It means 'a short interesting story about a real person or event'. (किसी व्‍यक्ति या घटना के विषय में रोचक लघुकथा; कि़स्‍सा चुटकला, लतीफ़ा)
 
 
• *Example: He told me some **anecdotes**.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__*** Anecdote.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Legend**: an old story that may or may not be true. [प्राचीन कथा (जिसका सत्‍य या असत्‍य होना प्रासंगिक नहीं); आख्‍यान, किंवदंती, दंतकथा, लोककथा]
 
• **Myth**: a story from past times, especially one about gods and men of courage. Myths often explain natural or historical events. [मिथक, पौराणिक कथा (जो विशेषतया देवताओं और वीर पुरुषों के विषय में होती हैं और जिनमें प्रायः प्राकृतिक या ऐतिहासिक घटनाओं का वर्णन होता है)]
 
• **Epic**: very long and exciting. (बहुत लंबा और उत्तेजना भरा)
